title: Bram and the Bridge
author: L. M. Hartwell
blurb: Tamsin Ishikawa, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, has spent twelve years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
